recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-19762; any future change to these invariants should be handled as a separate StructureDefinition/FHIRPath decision.
issue_request: FHIR-19762 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that StructureDefinition sdf-8 not require logical-model element paths to start with StructureDefinition.type when that type may be an absolute URL; the resolution also said sdf-8a should be improved.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 23442c23d35695b1ae37fd2eb10328549e2fbc25, merged as PR HL7/fhir#364 in 9287c80b311e387cd41e99581e7852ad14b286af. That change updated the old StructureDefinition spreadsheet expressions for sdf-8 and sdf-8a and fixed the FHIRPath replaceMatches handling needed by the sdf-8a expression.
additional_context: The current build-scope source is source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml because source/fhir.ini actively lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition. Current StructureDefinition.type prose still allows absolute URLs only for logical models and says their type name should start with the final URL path segment. Current sdf-8 and sdf-8a expressions skip the %resource.type root-name check for logical models and use the actual first element path/root for child paths. FHIR-26877 later corrected apostrophe escaping in the same sdf-8 expression and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active XML source already implements the requested logical-model exception for sdf-8 and the corresponding sdf-8a improvement, and the linked Zulip discussion matches the current expressions.
